@ScheduleManager/frmSummaryScheduleOfClass.cs  ở form này có         private void GetClassListID()
        {
            // khac nien ki thi load lai data            
            // khac nien hoac ki hoac lop thi load lai data

            strClassListID = "";

            if (uClass.ClassType == 0) // la lop thuong
            {

                DataRow[] rows = dtbBigAndSmallClass.Select("OriginClassID='" + uClass.ClassIDEditValue.ToString() + "'");
                foreach (DataRow drw in rows)
                {
                    strClassListID += "," + drw["ClassID"].ToString();
                }
            }
            // them ma chinh lop do vao
            strClassListID += "," + uClass.ClassIDEditValue.ToString() + ",";
        }
